verdict.rationale: Algolia's official docs explicitly market 'AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search' as a first-class capability, alongside its long-standing keyword relevance/ranking engine, indicating fused semantic+keyword retrieval in a single query. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking or community confirmation specifically of hybrid vector+keyword fusion (community evidence only covers classic keyword/typo-tolerance search, not NeuralSearch specifically), and no detailed API-level documentation of query parameters for hybrid mode.
